text:
Alex Kim: FYI customer AcmeApps getting repeated JSON parsing failures with json_mode=structured + streaming=true. They also reported a sudden billing spike. Pasting sample response we captured.

Alex Kim: ```json
{
  "orders": [
    {"id": "a1", "items": [{"sku": "x1", "qty": 1}]},
    {"id": "a2", "items": [{"sku": "x2"}], "temp_meta": "orphan"},
    {"id": "a3", "items": null}
  ]
}
```

Viola Chen: Can you paste the exact request payload, schema and request id? Need model and json schema to repro.

Alex Kim: Request snippet: ```http
POST /v1/responses
{
  "model": "redwood-instruct-1",
  "json_mode": "structured",
  "streaming": true,
  "schema": {"orders": [{"id": "string", "items": [{"sku": "string", "qty": "number"}]}]},
  "input": "batch of 3 orders"
}
```
Request-ID: req_0ab12, org: acme-123.

Support Bot: Ticket INC-2026 created for AcmeApps.

Sanjay Patel: I see a latency spike and some 502s around that time in serving metrics. Any chance the client set streaming=true and reassembled chunks incorrectly?

Alex Kim: Yes customer uses streaming=true. They said downstream parser fails because some items arrive with extra keys (temp_meta) and some items missing qty.

Irene Gomez: Reproduced locally using their request id. Looks like a chunk boundary cut inside an object and the reassembly caused an orphaned key to attach to the following object. Small log trace:```
stream: ... {"id":"a2","items":[{"sku":"x2"}
<chunk end>
<chunk start>: ,"temp_meta":"orphan"} ...
```

Sanjay Patel: Root cause likely streaming chunk framing not aligned with JSON-mode framing. Workarounds: force streaming=false or use object-per-event framing on client. Longer term we should buffer mid-object and validate schema server-side to avoid emitting orphan keys.

Alex Kim: Customer is in prod and the retries from their parser broke and retried, causing token usage/billing spike. They want a quick mitigation.

Viola Chen: Action items: 1) Immediate customer workaround: set streaming=false or use "streaming_policy": "object_per_event". 2) Eng: triage and prioritize (assign to @Sanjay). 3) Support: evaluate provisional billing credit if overage > $500 — @Irene to confirm. I'll follow up with customer mail.

Irene Gomez: Confirmed we can provisionally credit up to $800 while we investigate. Logging to billing ops.

Sanjay Patel: Opening BUG-3451. Plan: detect mid-object chunk boundaries in runtime, buffer until full object completed, add strict schema validation pass to drop unknown keys and emit structured logs. ETA: patch by EOD.

Alex Kim: Thanks. I'll pass workaround and ask SDK version + any extra traces from customer.

Support Bot: INC-2026 updated — ASSIGNED to Sanjay Patel.
